abstract: Just 16 Mega Universities (MUs) collectively enroll 5 percent of all undergraduate and over 10 percent of graduate students in the U.S., yet little is known about how these predominantly online institutions fit into the postsecondary education landscape. We leverage new data covering the universe of federal student aid applicants to describe students served, degrees and geographic specializations, and student outcomes at MUs. MU enrollment is concentrated in the rural south, mid-Atlantic, and southwest, where up to 20 percent of federal higher education aid recipients attend MUs. MUs compete broadly with other open-access institutions and specialize in fields like business, computer and information sciences, and homeland security. MU students have lower average completion rates and leave with higher average student loan debt compared to students at ”competitor” schools, defined using preferences indicated through federal aid applications. For undergraduate students on the margin of MU enrollment, completion rates tend to be lower and both student loan take-up and default higher compared to demographically similar peers with identical college preferences who enroll in other institutions, though heterogeneity exists across individual MUs.
title: The Influence of Mega Universities on college competition and outcomes
title_zh: 巨型大学对高校竞争与成果的影响

abstract: This paper traces the evolution of political outcomes in Civil War refugee camps, where roughly 600,000 enslaved African Americans achieved freedom. Refugee camps became sites of African American empowerment after the war, but these accomplishments were followed by a backlash that overturned the progressive outlook by the early 1900s. Despite the backlash, African Americans enjoyed persistently higher rates of literacy in counties home to refugee camps, fostering a sustained, selected outmigration of whites and enabling improved interracial relations. Today, progressive politics enjoy an advantage at these sites of former emancipation, and whites are key contributors to this progressive outlook. Overall, while progressive achievements may provoke backlash, they can also set in motion the very conditions that eventually erode resistance and foster renewed political progress.
abstract_zh: 本文追溯了美国内战难民集中营中政治结果的演变，约60万被奴役的非裔美国人在这里获得了自由。战后，难民集中营成为非裔美国人赋权之地，但这些成就随后遭遇反弹，至20世纪初，进步前景被颠覆。尽管存在反弹，但曾设有难民集中营的县中，非裔美国人的识字率持续较高，这促进了白人选择性迁出的持续现象，并改善了种族间关系。如今，在这些曾经的解放之地，进步政治占据优势，而白人是这一进步前景的关键贡献者。总体而言，尽管进步成就可能引发反弹，但它们也能催生最终削弱阻力、推动政治进步重新发展的条件。
title: Legacies of liberation: political dynamics in Civil War refugee camps
title_zh: 解放的遗产：内战难民营中的政治动态

abstract: We propose kernel estimators for the densities of persistent and transient inefficiencies in a generalized panel data stochastic frontier model. This approach relaxes the conventional distributional assumptions imposed on the inefficiencies, thereby increasing robustness. A Bayesian sampling algorithm is developed to estimate all model parameters and unobserved entities, as well as the bandwidths needed to construct the densities of persistent and transient inefficiencies. The advantages of our estimator and sampling algorithm are demonstrated through numerical studies based on pseudo-samples. We find that our estimation approach outperforms conventional Bayesian estimation, providing more accurate estimates of firm-level inefficiencies. We also apply the approach to analyze the cost frontier and related characteristics for a panel of large US commercial banks, and discuss differences relative to the traditional Bayesian framework. Our estimator reveals that the high-density region of transient inefficiency varies over time, whereas the conventional approach does not possess such a feature. Moreover, the contribution of persistent inefficiency to the total inefficiency revealed by our approach is slightly more than half of that suggested by the conventional framework.
abstract_zh: 我们针对广义面板数据随机前沿模型中的持久性与暂时性无效率密度，提出了核估计方法。该方法放宽了对无效率项的传统分布假设，从而增强了稳健性。我们开发了一种贝叶斯采样算法，用以估计所有模型参数、未观测实体以及构建持久性和暂时性无效率密度所需的带宽。通过基于伪样本的数值研究，我们展示了所提估计器及采样算法的优势。研究发现，我们的估计方法优于传统贝叶斯估计，能更精确地估计企业层面的无效率。我们还应用该方法分析了一组大型美国商业银行的成本前沿及相关特征，并讨论了与传统贝叶斯框架的差异。我们的估计器揭示，暂时性无效率的高密度区域随时间变化，而传统方法不具备此特性。此外，我们方法揭示的持久性无效率对总无效率的贡献，略高于传统框架所建议的一半。
title: Bayesian estimation of a semiparametric stochastic frontier model with persistent and transient inefficiencies
title_zh: 具有持久性和暂时性低效率的半参数随机前沿模型的贝叶斯估计
